spatialResolutionNote: NASA POWER documentation (https://power.larc.nasa.gov/docs/methodology/data/sources_meteorology/) states the primary meteorological source is a 1/2 degree latitude by 5/8 degree longitude grid from GMAO MERRA-2. The response header lists the sources as MERRA2 and POWER. Values are grid-cell averages, not measurements at the farm. Precipitation here is PRECTOTCORR (bias-corrected); POWER documents the higher-resolution GPM IMERG product (0.1 degree) as separate parameters, which this snapshot does not use.
